body:
## Summary

- Add the on-demand `systems-audit` skill, evidence method, and Systems Auditor handoff for eight scopes. Reports retain the existing headings, record clean and `INCOMPLETE` outcomes accurately, cap displayed findings by department, and remain ignored-local under `audits/`.
- Validate an explicit report against an explicit audited project root. Keep traversal and physical containment checks when the runtime is installed outside the project.
- Package the skill and canonical runtime across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Hermes. Hermes now keeps a managed runtime beside its configuration with source hashes, drift refusal, rollback for fetched skill mismatches, and stale managed-file retirement. Codex verifies its marketplace and installed plugin source before creating agent profiles.
- Update installation and adapter guidance, both READMEs, the 20-skill inventory, and v0.9.5 manifests, changelog, release notes, and prepublication ledger evidence. Codex uses `$systems-audit`; Claude Code and OpenCode use `/sefi:audit`; Hermes uses its native skill from a direct request.

## Verification

- Slice 1, Slice 2, and Slice 3 independent QA passed. Installer security review and its source-binding recheck passed.
- Independent behavioral scenarios cover routing, scopes, clean and incomplete reports, finding caps and overflow, report collisions, and installed-runtime report validation. Candidate checks exercised real isolated Claude and Codex plugin installs, OpenCode's installer, and Hermes's native-install call shape with an isolated CLI fixture. A real isolated Codex CLI install and source/profile verification exited 0.
- Independent final-candidate QA passed on commit tree `f0faaba6c1bc9b193cea1afe3d152940c67fc9b0` after running the targeted audit, routing, installation, documentation, inventory, and release-contract checks. The Windows installer matrix reached its 300-second bound after the Hermes unrelated-content check; its remaining tail, the full local suite, and placeholder/link scans remain PENDING. Completed hosted Linux CI is required before merge.

## Release

This PR prepares v0.9.5. After merge and CI on the release commit, public-source installation checks, the `v0.9.5` tag, the GitHub release, and the six-surface ledger follow-up are separate publication steps.
title: feat(audit): ship systems-audit across four harnesses for v0.9.5
